review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Business Unit Overview Our Operations unit is the engine room of Superloop - responsible for maintaining and supporting all of our products and internal technical infrastructure to ensure the best possible service to both our customers and our very own business. Our Operations unit is responsible for ensuring that the business has the technical capability and capacity to deliver services to all Superloop customers ranging from Home Broadband to International Wholesale. This is an enterprise/corp
eligibility_evidence: Our Operations unit is responsible for ensuring that the business has the technical capability and capacity to deliver services to all Superloop customers ranging from Home Broadband to International Wholesale.
Manage domestic and international WAN connectivity, carrier relationships, and service provider engagements.
Design and support secure connectivity between AWS and corporate network environments, including Direct Connect, VPN, and hybrid cloud solutions.
As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds to apply, regardless of gender, age, faith, ethnicity, nationality, sexuality, neurodiversity, or physical ability.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Support high-availability routing, switching, storage networking, and disaster recovery connectivity requirements. Qualifications And Experience 7+ years’ experience supporting enterprise networks across multiple sites and countries. Proven expertise with routing and switching technologies, particularly BGP, OSPF, and advanced Layer 2/Layer 3 networking. Hands-on experience with SD-WAN solutions.
